summary.text: Marvin Holmes, Jr. is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 23 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A business executive and U.S. Coast Guard veteran, he previously served as Majority Caucus Leader.

paragraphs.text: Holmes was born in Cleveland, Ohio, and served in the U.S. Coast Guard from 1970 to 1974.

His career experience includes working as CEO of M. E. Holmes Enterprises, LLC, as director of the Real Estate Division of the Maryland Housing Coalition Brokerage, and as a new home sales consultant with the U.S. Home Corporation.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists Holmes as vice chair of the Rules & Executive Nominations Committee and as a member of the Administrative, Executive and Legislative Review Committee and the Environment and Transportation Committee.
